correctness.rationale: With arc-incidence (not projected) coordinates, the union support of two paths decomposes into r maximal mismatch runs and exposes exactly 2^r recombinations; for r=1 it is an edge, while for r>=2 swapping one branch yields x+y=u+v, so no edge. Unique intervals give degree. Sum_{interval} tensor_{i in interval}(J_{n_i}-I_{n_i}) produces each spectrum eigenvalue via constant/orthogonal factors; multiplicities and Kirchhoff tree count follow, including unique zero by single-coordinate adjacency. Binary padded transition count changes by at most 2 per interval toggle, and each run is removable in one step; the even-boundary map identifies classical halved cube. For q>=3 a third symbol at each coordinate gives x-z-y in two steps; disjoint mismatch positions 1 and 3 witness exact diameter 2, k<=2 complete.
